kalrn_rs2173852_genetics_summary.als_gwas_natural_experiment_paradox: Despite 37.7% of non-Finnish Europeans carrying G/C or C/C at rs2173852 (NFE AF=21.07%) and >99.9% power in van Rheenen 2021 (29,612 ALS vs 122,656 controls) for OR<=0.91, rs2173852 and KALRN show 0 ALS/FTD GWAS credible sets in Open Targets v4 (vs 6 ALS GWAS credible sets peaking at p=4.04e-25 for UNC13A rs12608932), arguing against Intron 56 Kalirin-12/DuET cryptic splicing as a rate-limiting human motor-ALS survival determinant.

gtex_v8_kalrn_brain_cortex_sqtl_summary.biological_interpretation: All 82 baseline GTEx Brain_Cortex sQTLs regulate the Kalirin-7 alternative terminal exon cluster (~124.50-124.56 Mb); rs2173852 (124,701,255) has 0 baseline CNS eQTL/sQTLs in TDP-43-intact brains and acts conditionally upon nuclear TDP-43 loss.

chembl_atg4b_summary.modality_conclusion: All 995 ChEMBL bioactivity records for human ATG4B (CHEMBL1741221) derive from catalytic inhibitor campaigns (0 small-molecule activators), confirming small-molecule chemistry acts in the wrong pharmacological direction for ALS loss-of-function and locking intrathecal steric SSO (#1 chr2:241668981-241668998(+)) as the sole mechanism-matched rescue modality.

kozareva_2025_atg4b_validation.title: Integrative multiomic analysis links TDP-43-driven splicing defects to cascading proteomic disruption of ALS/FTD pathways
kozareva_2025_atg4b_validation.key_finding: Generated paired RNA-seq + proteomics in TDP-43-depleted human iPSC neurons (>700-protein subnetwork enriched for mRNA processing, synaptic function, and autophagy) and experimentally validated network-predicted effects of cryptic splicing in ATG4B alongside STMN2 and DAPK1.

vandijk_2026_snrna_stmn2_ce_states.title: Pathology-defined cell states reveal reproducible transcriptomic signatures across ALS cortical single-nucleus RNA-seq studies
vandijk_2026_snrna_stmn2_ce_states.key_finding: Across 4 cortical ALS snRNA-seq cohorts (140 donors, 87 ALS), conventional case-control DE clusters by study, whereas STMN2-cryptic-exon-positive nuclei reveal reproducible TDP-43 signatures while sparse polyadenylation site changes were not reproducibly detected across cohorts.

ATG4B.rationale: gnomAD v4.1 pLI=0.00/LOEUF=0.851; intrathecal steric SSO restores physiological splicing (non-inhibitory); Atg4b-KO mice viable with inner-ear/autophagy phenotype; 995 ChEMBL records are inhibitors (wrong direction).

KALRN.rationale: gnomAD v4.1 pLI=1.00/LOEUF=0.231 (v2.1.1=0.179) prohibits pan-inhibition and demands zero accidental Exon 56/57 skipping; high vascular GTEx TPM (Artery_Aorta=37.39, Artery_Coronary=23.12 vs cervical cord=1.50) requires CNS-confined intrathecal steric SSO.

ELK1.rationale: 3'Ext RNase-H gapmer lowers transcript abundance in X-linked TF (gnomAD v4.1 chrX=null; v2.1.1 LOEUF=0.616; Ovary=80.11, Liver=14.60 TPM); nuclear pELK1-SRF neuroprotection vs dendritic pro-apoptotic sign unresolved.

head_to_head_intervals.label: Torres2024_ASO_3J_16bp_6LNA_benchmark
head_to_head_intervals.lna_count_and_tm_note: Torres et al. 2024 PMC11416411 Table 3 specifies 6 LNA positions (1,4,7,10,13,16) across 15 PS linkages (unconjugated); +3.0 C/LNA is an unmeasured additive heuristic.

atg4b_torres2024_3j_head_to_head_benchma.torres2024_pip8b2_kim1_nephrotoxicity_no: Torres et al. 2024 (PMID:39305312, PMC11416411) evaluated two distinct constructs: (1) unconjugated 16-nt 6-LNA/15-PS mixmer ASO 3J (Table 3, chr2:241668980-241668995(+)), transfected at 5-100 nM with Lipofectamine RNAiMAX in TARDBP-KD HeLa cells (Fig. 6c), and (2) systemic IV 25-nt peptide-conjugated PMO Pip8b2-ATG4B targeting the TDP-43 binding site (10 mg/kg, Fig. 6a,b), which caused transient Day-2 mouse urinary KIM-1 elevation resolving by Day 7. Sequence off-target counts (10/18/5 vs #2 0/0/0) quantify transcriptome sequence hits rather than measured in vivo toxicity; naked intrathecal 2'-O-MOE CSF dosing avoids cationic CPP renal exposure.

celf5_afdb_and_3nmr_rrm2_truncation.pdb_homolog_id: 3NMR (PMID:20947024, CELF1 RRM1-RRM2:UGUU homolog projection; no experimental CELF5 RRM2 structure)
celf5_afdb_and_3nmr_rrm2_truncation.structural_mechanism_verdict: Truncation after Pro201 excises beta4 (202-214) in AF-Q8N6W0-F1, severing anti-parallel beta4-beta1 backbone H-bonds and projected C-terminal UGUU RNA-clamp contacts (mapped from CELF1 homolog PDB 3NMR) while leaving RRM1 (46-121; 0 inter-domain contacts) decoupled across a flexible linker: primary loss-of-function + unfolded RRM2(134-201)+29aa chaperone/granule burden rather than high-affinity competitive RNA dominant-negativity.

celf5_local_lsv_nmd_and_ejc_audit.local_lsv_phasing_note: Brown 2022 MOESM11 quantifies local MAJIQ LSVs with distinct denominators (canonical junction 3278110-3281199 KD E[PSI]=0.546 in donor LSV vs 0.633 in acceptor LSV; upstream 3225618-3244124 is annotated novel_acceptor with blank ir_start/ir_end, not intron-1 retention) and is measured in NMD-competent i3Neurons; whole-transcript phasing bounds cannot be algebraically summed from unphased local LSVs and require long-read ONT/Iso-Seq.

ejc_nmd_minigene_trap.assay_mandate: On MANE NM_021938.4, the cryptic PTC ends 18 nt (<50-55 nt EJC threshold, PMID:9671053) upstream of CE-Exon6 and 165 nt upstream of Exon6-Exon7: a 3-exon Exon5-CE-Exon6 minigene can measure primary splice-site %PSI choice, but evades canonical EJC-dependent NMD; NMD/stability and isoform-phasing validation require endogenous multi-exon transcripts (consistent with Zeng et al. 2025 PMID:40672339 [PREPRINT] PMC12265704 showing NMD inhibition raises cryptic CELF5 PSI from 24.8% to 44.6%, FDR=0.0235) + Exon 1-7+ ONT/Iso-Seq.
